caseName: Fleisher Engineering & Construction Co. v. United States ex rel. Hallenbeck
caseNameFull: Fleisher Engineering & Construction Co. v. United States for the use and benefit of Hallenbeck
attorneys: Mr. Frank Gibbons for petitioners., Alice B. Marion for respondent.

opinions.text: The petition for rehearing is granted. The order denying certiorari, ante, p. 677, is vacated and the petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit is granted.
